# `dotnet-inspect`

*   https://github.com/richlander/dotnet-inspect

```shell
dotnet tool install -g dotnet-inspect
```

*   for .NET  

    *   features

        *   view metadata, 
        
        *   view APIs, 
        
        *   view vulnerabilities
        
        *   view provenance
        
        *   compare versions

    *   containerland equivalent

        ```shell
        docker inspect
        ```

        ```shell
        kubectl describe
        ```
     are for container land —
